tspan.tspan: NT Server Back Ups - Job Flow (opcn002d)
This job is run manually by GDW support to recover
COGNOS NT Server backups onto the HP platform.
They are then accessed using WINZIP from any PC.
Instructions for it's use are in the job itself
Each of the individual COGNOS NT servers will have run it's own backup process which ZIPs
up all the critical files into a ZIP file that is located on
The jobs in this flow then sweep up all these backup files that are on each NT COGNOS
The backups FTPed from each server are then combined into a single file using the TAR utility
and then FTPed to a GDG file on the MVS host.
